Position Summary
We are seeking a Big Data Engineer to join DataWave Solutions, a fast-growing enterprise analytics practice that builds scalable data platforms and delivers data products for Fortune 500 clients. The successful candidate will be an early member of our engineering squad focused on building reliable, production-grade data pipelines, data marts, and transformation layers to support analytics, reporting, and machine learning use cases. This role requires hands-on development of ETL/ELT processes, strong programming skills, and practical experience with cloud data services. The engineer will collaborate with data scientists, product managers, and platform engineers to deliver high-quality, maintainable data solutions.

Key Responsibilities

Data Platform Development and Pipeline Engineering
- Design, develop, test, and deploy robust, repeatable data ingestion and transformation pipelines to support batch and near-real-time use cases.
- Implement ELT/ETL patterns that move data from transactional and third-party systems into the cloud data platform, ensuring data quality, lineage, and observability.
- Build modular, reusable components and libraries to standardize ingestion, transformation, and error-handling logic.

Cloud Integration and Operations
- Implement and operate cloud-native data solutions using managed services and best practices for security, scalability, and cost control.
- Automate provisioning, deployment, and monitoring of data infrastructure components through Infrastructure-as-Code and CI/CD pipelines.
- Troubleshoot production issues, perform root cause analysis, and implement fixes and improvements to increase platform reliability.

Data Modeling, Performance, and Governance
- Collaborate with analytics and data science stakeholders to design dimensional and semantic models optimized for query performance and analytics usability.
- Implement data partitioning, compression, and indexing strategies to improve storage and query efficiency.
- Apply data governance practices including metadata capture, cataloging, access controls, and compliance with organizational policies.

Collaboration, Documentation, and Mentoring
- Work closely with cross-functional teams to gather requirements, translate them into technical designs, and deliver on sprint commitments.
- Produce clear technical documentation, runbooks, and onboarding materials for new datasets and pipelines.
- Mentor junior engineers, participate in code reviews, and promote engineering best practices across the team.

Required Qualifications

Experience
- 2-5 years

Technical Skills (Required / Mandatory)
- Python
- AWS or Snowflake

Preferred Qualifications (Good-to-have)
- Apache Spark
- Apache Airflow
- Experience with data modeling for analytics, SQL performance tuning, and familiarity with BI tools.
- Exposure to containerization, IaC (e.g., Terraform), and CI/CD tooling for data applications.

Success Metrics
- Timely delivery of high-quality data pipelines: percentage of pipelines delivered on schedule and meeting acceptance criteria.
- System reliability: reduction in production incidents and mean time to recovery (MTTR) for data platform services.
- Data quality and completeness: measurable improvements in data accuracy, freshness, and coverage for prioritized datasets.
- Performance improvements: demonstrable reductions in query latency and cost-per-query for key analytics workloads.
- Team enablement: number of reusable components, templates, and documentation items produced; onboarding time for new datasets reduced.

Location and Work Mode
- Hybrid: Bengaluru, 3 days a week in the office.

About DataWave Solutions
DataWave Solutions is a specialized data engineering and analytics company focused on building enterprise-grade data platforms that help clients make faster, data-driven decisions. We offer a collaborative environment, ongoing learning opportunities, and exposure to multiple industry domains.
